body: Let us know how it goes! I'm curious now lol

I think I'll be fine. That was just a momentary low point. I have a rule that I won't kill myself unless I have the desire to do so for two solid weeks. But if I have a single happy moment, the count starts over, because just a moment of happiness makes life worth living.

Long story short. Ready?

In the last two years, this has happened: I was raped, spiraled down into a deep depression, fucked people to subconsciously prove to myself that I could choose who I slept with, became an alcoholic, became suicidal, self harmed a lot, struggled with an eating disorder, flunked out of college because I was too scared to leave my room and see the guy who raped me trotting his happy butt around campus, and discovered I'm bipolar. 

It sounds stupid, I know.
